title: No sentences or debug readouts anywhere in the chrome
goal: User 2026-09-25, pointing at the timeline bar's 'Playhead no animated property @ 0.00s' pill: 'I don't like how you're throwing big sentences into the ui like this... completely unprofessional ux.' That pill (TimelineDock.swift:205, keyBar/readoutPill) was copied from the mock (video.html:617 .kfread, fallback text at video.html:1284); the user now rejects it, so this overrides the mock and the mock line is removed with a note citing this task. The 60-character CopyBudget (fe5bd41d) only reads panel sections, so the timeline bar, tool bar, transport, overlays, popovers and empty states were never checked. Standard: professional editors (Premiere, Final Cut, Photoshop) show values and controls, never sentences about state and never 'no X' placeholders; when there is nothing to show, show nothing.
acceptance: The playhead readout pill is removed from the timeline bar; the time is already in the transport. The Easing control shows only when one or more keys are selected (it applies to them), otherwise it is absent
docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html drops the .kfread readout, with an HTML comment citing the user's 2026-09-25 rejection

Every string shown in chrome outside the panel (timeline, transport, tool bar and its options, canvas overlays, HUDs, popovers, toasts, empty states, status pills) is listed with its source; any that describes state in a sentence, reads like a debug value ('@', raw ids, 'no X', parenthetical explanations) or exceeds 30 characters is rewritten as a label or removed, with a before/after picture of each
CopyBudget extends to those surfaces with a shrink-only offender list that ends this task empty for video surfaces

A rule in UX-PATTERNS and runner-prompt: no sentence or placeholder readout in chrome; an empty state is empty or a single short label; mock text that reads like a debug value is not copied, it is raised as a card
A walk at Next defaults photographs the timeline bar with nothing selected, a layer selected, and a key selected, and each shows only labels and controls
